meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: India's overall balance of payments (DBIE report 56)
meta.coverage: Balance of payments, the headline net lines: current account, goods, services, remittances, income, capital flows, reserves
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 56, US$ million, fiscal quarters (Q1 = April to June), net = credit minus debit as published. Latest revision of each quarter. Reserve change is signed as RBI signs it: an increase in reserves is a negative entry.
